title: Filter, map, reduce
prompt: Retype the snippet exactly. Brackets and quotes are not closed for you.

snippet.javascript:
const orders = [{ total: 40, paid: true }, { total: 15, paid: false }]
const revenue = orders
  .filter((o) => o.paid)
  .map((o) => o.total * 1.2)
  .reduce((sum, t) => sum + t, 0)
console.log(`Revenue: ${revenue.toFixed(2)}`)
snippet.typescript:
type Order = { total: number; paid: boolean }
const orders: Order[] = [{ total: 40, paid: true }, { total: 15, paid: false }]
const revenue = orders
  .filter((o) => o.paid)
  .map((o) => o.total * 1.2)
  .reduce((sum, t) => sum + t, 0)
console.log(`Revenue: ${revenue.toFixed(2)}`)
snippet.python:
orders = [{"total": 40, "paid": True}, {"total": 15, "paid": False}]
revenue = sum(o["total"] * 1.2 for o in orders if o["paid"])
squares = {n: n ** 2 for n in range(5) if n % 2 == 0}
print(f"Revenue: {revenue:.2f}", squares)
